summary:
Fixed `lis` decreasing `longest` when improving an intermediate tail. E.g. `lis([4,1,5,3,7,6,2])` dropped from 3 to 2 on final `2`. Changed `longest = length + 1` to `longest = max(longest, length + 1)` so `longest` only grows.
RESULT: FIXED
